contract: The supported Spokeo adapter is consumed through explicit console and discoverable native-provider operations for scan, prepare, approved submit and verify. Every action targets an existing consented durable case at an exact revision. Preparation submits nothing and returns disabled, contract-only or live readiness explicitly. Submission requires a per-request approval checkbox/constant, native tool approval, the exact approval phrase and, outside a contract server, the disabled-by-default runtime live-submit gate. Verification confirms removal only from a later negative provider rescan.
remaining_limits: Local qualification uses a real HTTP contract server implementing the supported Spokeo request and response protocol; it is protocol evidence, not proof that the live broker currently accepts the flow
Contract-server readiness is labelled separately from live-broker readiness in the console
No live Spokeo opt-out was submitted during development; live submission requires both exact owner approval text and GIDEON_ALLOW_LIVE_SPOKEO_SUBMIT=1
Spokeo CAPTCHA, changed forms, cross-origin actions, redirects and inconclusive verification fail closed or require a human
Other data brokers remain catalog/manual-case entries without provider adapters; this slice does not claim full broker parity
Dashboard registration of capabilities_wellbeing_broker_spokeo.register remains a root-owned shared integration hook
integration_hooks: Register gideon.interfaces.dashboard.handlers.capabilities_wellbeing_broker_spokeo.register with the shared dashboard application; no shared registration file is changed in this slice
acceptance_coverage: real HTTP console scan, preparation, separately approved submission and negative-rescan verification persist durable provider outcomes
console labels contract-only readiness and never submits during preparation or before the approval checkbox
native app registry resolves an actual provider factory with a canonical-origin-only settings signature
four exact native schemas require tool approval and submission additionally requires the literal owner approval phrase
production factory cannot accept caller home, arbitrary provider origin, contract mode or endpoint overrides
generic manual broker cases retain their existing non-provider workflow

repairs: Awaited the durable case-list refresh after opt-out preparation instead of reading the prior revision synchronously
Aligned the final UI assertion with the typed adapter ledger evidence basis provider_protocol; verified_rescan belongs to the separate legacy verifier path

active_continuation: Email-based broker removal and verification workflow; existing Spokeo adapter qualification remains retained.
